advisory.finding: The new fallback-chain intersection of the web capability (`native_web_search=all(c.native_web_search for c in per_candidate)`) has no test. The suite pins the sibling `supports_temperature` intersection with a positive and negative control, but nothing exercises a fallback chain of mixed native/non-native candidates, so the whole-chain record collapsing to the conservative value is unverified — inverting `all` to `any` (attesting `native` when only one candidate supports it) would pass every test.

advisory.finding: The new injected-test-model gate `web_requested = bool(req.web) and not self._model_override` is untested. Every runner-threading test drives a real provider string (no model_override), so the `and not self._model_override` conjunct — which the runner docstring calls 'The ONLY thing that can withdraw' web access — is never exercised; removing it would fail no test, and no test asserts a `web=True` request under model_override yields `web_access: "off"` / no `capabilities` kwarg.
scenarios: A regression that drops the `and not self._model_override` conjunct: an injected test-model run would then attach web capabilities and provenance would attest a route the test double cannot serve.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a test using a FunctionModel model_override with req.web=True asserting `'capabilities' not in kwargs` and `provider_provenance['capabilities']['web_access'] == 'off'`.
